note: BLM campground on the North Platte below Gray Reef, near Alcova, with float and fishing access. Each site has a shelter, table, fire ring and tent pad beside its RV parking. Busiest in spring and early summer. --Claude
summary: BLM page current: 7 FCFS sites, $10, 14-day limit, vault toilet, no water. TEMPORARILY CLOSED since Aug 31, 2026 for county repair of the access road (CR 412), no reopening date - status written. Waterfront lead: riverview -> riverfront (lower shelters ~30 m from the river over sagebrush, no forest band). Phone empty -> BLM Casper FO.
flags: STATUS: temporarily closed since 2026-08-31 for repair of County Road 412 (Gray Reef Road), 'No completion date is currently available' - written as status; not a drop (add-with-caveat rule).

WATERFRONT LEAD riverview -> riverfront (stored evidence is wrong about a forest band): on Esri imagery the lower shelters sit ~27-35 m from the North Platte's water edge (river ~100 m wide) over low sagebrush with a loop trail between, no tree line - shelters at ~42.57901,-106.68580 (~27 m), ~42.57905,-106.68530 (~33 m) and ~42.57919,-106.68459 (~32 m); a fourth at ~42.57915,-106.68585 (~40 m). BLM numbers no sites; all 7 are sold by the night (FCFS). The upper three shelters along the entry road are ~80-130 m back. Stored value is not --AWH; results don't change waterfront - reviewer's call. The bank height above the water could not be measured from imagery.
